svg.title: MetaHarness: the capability walkthrough
svg.desc: Twenty-chapter animated explainer. Introduction: a repository becomes a custom agent product. Subsequent chapters reveal cards in sequence, with commands and practical outcomes. Three minutes twenty seconds. Experimental features are labeled. Reduced motion shows a static overview.

g.text: Turn a repository into an agent your team can own, govern and improve.
A guided explainer. Practical workflows first. Experimental capabilities clearly labeled.
Build a harness you own. Keep the model replaceable.
Your own package: CLI + agents + tools + policy + memory.
Static analysis turns project structure into a starting plan.
README.md · Score any repo; USAGE.md · genome
Analysis proposes a plan. Inferred commands stay disabled until reviewed.
A local browser workflow, with public repo data fetched from GitHub.
USERGUIDE.md · What can I do with it?
Review recommendations locally, then download a branded package.
Generate a focused starting point, then make it yours.
Trim unnecessary tools and edit prompts before using the harness.
Adapters translate the same harness into each host’s integration format.
Choose a focused workflow instead of shipping every tool.
Template prompts and policies are starting points for your domain.
Domain agents, skills and commands remain yours to customize.
Keep the useful agents; remove the ones your team does not need.
MCP is an adapter surface, with access denied by default.
README.md · MCP; Prime Agent deny-lists require a sandbox
A denied tool stays denied. Host enforcement capabilities still matter.
Project memory and peer coordination are explicit capabilities.
Project state is scoped; credentials and peer trust require configuration.
Learn routing decisions from your own evaluation outcomes.
README.md · router; gains depend on workload
A quality target guides model selection; outcomes improve the routing fit.
Keep model weights frozen while testing harness changes.
Candidate → sandbox test → compare → retain or revert. No guaranteed lift.
AVO adds a governed inspect, edit, execute and repair loop.
README.md · AVO; stronger performance claim remains gated
Tool execution stays within capability, budget and promotion boundaries.
Field memory is opt-in and requires deployment configuration.
README.md · field-memory; experimental, off by default
Deployment must supply storage, adapter, identity verification and secret key.
An optional weight-tuning path complements harness evolution.
README.md · Weight-EFT; GPU-gated, no universal gain promised
Tune on training data; evaluate on separate tasks before accepting a model.
ARC-AGI-3 controller plus remote MCP and an Apps canvas.
README.md · private / experimental; no ARC performance claim
ChatGPT is the reasoning host. These ARC packages make no score claim.
Use focused checks before trusting or publishing a harness.
harness validate · harness audit · harness sbom
Readiness checks expose problems; they do not replace a security review.
Keep ownership while preserving evidence and update paths.
harness sign · harness verify · harness upgrade
Publish your package; consumers install your brand with npx.
Opt into recoverable sessions and inspect the tools you expose.
Resume from logs and compare replay state hashes across runtimes.
Evaluate quality and cost on your own work. Then ship.
README.md · Quality gates / leaderboard; open Studio to start
Choose one known repo. Review the output. Run its checks. Then iterate.
A factory for custom agent harnesses you own.
Analyze repos · Scaffold agents · Browser Studio
Host adapters · Domain templates · MCP policy
